summary: Resets/initializes a multi-block bitmap state. Clears the first DWORD at this+0x0, then processes four bitmap blocks whose metadata lives at this+0x1C (entry per block: start-position word at +0, bit-count word at +2) indexed by this+0x34/0x38/0x3C/0x40. Block 1 (this+0x34) OR/ANDs a single low bit into the bitmap bytes at this+0x14 via IndexToBitmaskConversion. Blocks 2 and 3 (this+0x38, this+0x3C) clear every bit through BitSetClearOperation. Block 4 (this+0x40) builds a selection mask via ComputeBitmaskFromBitmapEntryCount and clears/sets bits per that mask. Ends with BitfieldEncoder(this+0x44, 0), SimpleSetter_7500 on this+0x8, and zeroes this+0x48/0x4C/0x50, returning 0.
